answer: What survives to the river is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Every claim climbs the nebula of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the beacon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, held in escrow until finality, no identity may audit its own recruit. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
